summary_short_sentences.text: Software engineer with 3 years of experience building production Flutter applications and scalable backend integrations.

bullets.text: Architected custom Backend-for-Frontend (BFF) endpoints in Spring Boot to streamline mobile API integration, reducing integration time by 40% and unblocking parallel development cycles.

Shipped a full-stack sports management platform to the App Store and Google Play Store, building 10+ data-driven Flutter screens and integrating 15+ RESTful backend services for real-time data synchronization.
Spearheaded the legacy codebase refactor to Riverpod and GoRouter under Clean Architecture, eliminating critical bugs across core user flows and reducing overall app binary size by 15%.
Established a strict testing culture by writing comprehensive unit and widget tests with Mockito, achieving ~80% code coverage.
Integrated Firebase Crashlytics, Remote Config, and Auth as core platform features to improve crash visibility, remote configurability, and secure sign-in.
Mentored a junior developer on scalable Flutter architecture and state management standards to improve long-term codebase maintainability.
Set up automated build and deployment pipelines with GitHub Actions, improving release reliability and build consistency across projects.

Designed a privacy-first resume parsing and candidate scoring engine using a locally hosted Mistral 7B LLM, replacing commercial third-party APIs to guarantee data confidentiality and cut operational costs.
Designed and shipped a modular FastAPI backend exposing endpoints for resume parsing, job description matching, and automated interview orchestration.
Containerized the complete multi-model AI system (Mistral 7B, Whisper STT, gTTS, FastAPI) using Docker, creating reproducible container images for local execution and production deployment.

Built an initial layout-extraction pipeline combining YOLOv8 and spaCy (annotating hundreds of resume images in Label Studio for section segmentation) before evolving the system into an LLM-driven architecture to overcome dataset limitations and optimize hardware efficiency.
Engineered a resume-to-job description matcher using TF-IDF vectorization, cosine similarity, and embeddings to evaluate candidate relevance and return ranked shortlists.
Developed an AI-led pre-screening interview system combining OpenAI Whisper (Speech-to-Text) and Google TTS (gTTS) to conduct real-time voice-based candidate assessments.
Engineered the complete Flutter frontend for the "Lovester" dating application (`lovester.net`), achieving fluid 60fps user interfaces and complex custom animations across 25+ unique screens.
Transitioned the application from MVVM to a modular Clean Architecture focused on domain entities and unidirectional data flow, improving scalability for future development.
Led the architectural state management migration from Provider to Riverpod, improving code maintainability and accelerating onboarding for new feature development.

Established the foundational testing environment using Flutter's test framework, Mockito, Build Runner, and `FakeAsync` to execute unit, widget, and integration tests, catching regressions during development.
Debugged critical performance issues across user interaction flows, reducing app crashes and improving overall application stability and user experience.
Collaborated with design and backend teams during Agile sprints, communicating technical constraints and translating stakeholder requirements into optimized user flows and backend integrations.
Built the end-to-end Flutter frontend for "Voltisense," an IoT-connected household energy monitoring application that won **2nd Place out of 20+ engineering teams** in the Orange Summer Challenge.
Architected the mobile application adhering to Clean Architecture principles and utilizing GetX for state management and routing.

Engineered hardware pairing workflows and MQTT-based communication pipelines between IoT monitoring devices and the mobile app, streaming real-time energy consumption metrics to interactive graphs with sub-second latency.
Owned the model-to-mobile integration layer, allowing users to interact with forecasting models, view real-time energy insights, and track consumption.
Applied gamification principles within the mobile interface to enhance user engagement and encourage energy-saving behaviors.

Built an end-to-end local data lakehouse ingesting 5 seasons (~140K+ records) of Premier League data into LocalStack S3, with idempotent, retry-safe Python pipelines handling schema drift automatically.
Designed a dbt star schema on DuckDB with custom entity resolution reconciling ~2,000 player identities across disparate schemas, achieving 10/10 passing tests across 4 resolved collision classes.
Taught Flutter development and led UI/UX design workshops for students.
